name: zune-jpeg (JPEG decoder)
baseline: jpeg-decoder 0.3, the image crate's JPEG decoder before image 0.25
verdict_reason: The 1.5x-2x lead over jpeg-decoder was real enough that the image crate adopted zune-jpeg as its JPEG decoder in 0.25.0 (March 2024). Anyone decoding JPEG through image 0.25 already uses zune-jpeg, so adding it directly no longer beats the default.
tier_reason: The speedup is the author's own announcement figure with no workload or hardware attached, available via a mirror of the r/rust post.
claimed_speedup: zune-jpeg is 1.5x to 2x faster than jpeg-decoder and is on par with libjpeg-turbo (author, March 2023). Current first-party run on Darwin, baseline decode: mozjpeg 50.00 ms vs zune-jpeg 54.83 ms (1.097x slower)
workload: Not stated for the 1.5x-2x figure. Current zune-image benchmarks: decoding baseline, progressive and subsampled JPEGs, time per image.
platforms: Any; AVX2 and SSE intrinsics on x86_64, scalar path elsewhere
install: cargo add zune-jpeg (or use image 0.25, which uses it by default)
one_liner: Pure-Rust JPEG decoder, 1.5-2x faster than jpeg-decoder per its author; it is now the image crate's default JPEG decoder.
how_it_is_fast: zune-jpeg combines a fast Huffman decoder, an 8x8 integer IDCT and fast color conversion, using AVX2 and SSE intrinsics on x86_64 for the heavy loops.
use_it_when: You want JPEG decoding without the image crate's abstraction, for example to control decoder options or avoid image's dependency tree.
skip_it_when: You already decode through image 0.25 or later; it is the same decoder.
You need lossless JPEG, which jpeg-decoder still supports.
caveats: The 1.5x-2x figure has no published workload, hardware or version, and the original r/rust post is quoted here through a mirror.

The README says zune-jpeg should replace libjpeg-turbo "without any noticeable speed loss", but the author's 2026 Darwin run has it 1.10x to 1.34x slower than mozjpeg (libjpeg-turbo based) on baseline and subsampled images, and slightly faster on progressive ones.
The current benchmarks no longer include jpeg-decoder, so there is no recent head-to-head.
tradeoffs: Not bit-identical to libjpeg output, by design.
Uses unsafe platform intrinsics for SIMD.

evidence.quote: zune-jpeg is 1.5x to 2x faster than jpeg-decoder and is on par with libjpeg-turbo
| **No sampling Baseline decode**         | mozjpeg                      | 50.00 ms    | 24.30 MiB/s       | **Winner**        |
Switched to zune-jpeg for JPEG decoding.
This crate is in maintenance mode as _image-rs_ seeks to move over to the zune-jpeg crate.
`zune-jpeg` should easily replace `libjpeg-turbo` without any noticeable speed loss.
